hero.description: I build web products end to end: React and Vue frontends, Node backends on PostgreSQL, realtime features and integrations.
hero.status: Open to remote full-stack and frontend roles and contracts

unifiedone.name: UnifiedONE
unifiedone.summary: Security platform that connects Microsoft security signals, multi-vendor threat intelligence and cross-tenant knowledge.
points: Helped turn the codebase into a unified system of reusable components, making it maintainable and cutting the time spent on new development
Introduced unit testing for more stable code
Migrated the app from Vue 2 to Vue 3

autoservice.name: Auto service platform
autoservice.summary: Admin platform for an auto service: repair intake, service boards and work stages, planning, and a live queue of today’s cars.
points: Helped the business bring all management into one system, from orders to scheduling
Covered the business’s need for auto service management built around its own processes
autoservice.note: Built for a specific client under NDA, so there is no public link. The Repair Service project below covers the same domain.

repairservice.name: Repair Service
repairservice.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS for auto repair shops: companies and branches, a service board with drag and drop, clients, a calendar and realtime updates.
points: Tenant isolation is tested in every module, so one company never sees another’s data
Permissions are enforced on the server, and the UI only reflects them
Realtime updates across tabs, with edit-conflict detection on save
repairservice.note: The link opens a live demo with sample data.

vibewaller.name: Vibewaller
vibewaller.summary: Personal finance tracker: balance and assets, transaction history, category limits, self-employed taxes, a wishlist with price tracking, and expenses logged through a Telegram bot.
points: Built for my own needs, and I use it every day
Realtime sync and per-user data protection with Supabase RLS

footer.builtWith: Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Typefaces: Unbounded and Onest.

freelance: Built an admin platform for an auto service end to end: Vue 3 frontend, Node and PostgreSQL API with realtime updates.
Brought all of the business’s management into one system, from orders to scheduling.
Set up Google integration and CI/CD, and covered the system with unit, API and Playwright e2e tests.
quardex: Started as a project manager (Oct 2020 – Sep 2021), learned to code alongside it, then moved into frontend development.
After the frontend team left, delivered features in React and Strapi for a hosting client.
Built the company website in Nuxt from the designer’s mockups.
Built a component system shared across modules, so new screens reuse existing UI.
Made key pages faster and more responsive, and raised the code review bar.
nsoc360: Worked only on this client’s product as a Quardex employee: monitoring and analytics used by an EU customer.
Learned Vue on the live project, then built dashboards with AmCharts, tables, forms and role-based permissions.
Migrated the app from Vue 2 to Vue 3 on my own and wrote unit tests with Vitest.
Optimized state management on Vuex and Pinia.
Worked with cross-functional teams in an agile remote setup.
nda: Took the frontend from zero to production on my own, including its architecture and component system.
Built form components and validation that keep complex product flows reliable.
Shaped the UI and UX together with the product team.
